purpose: Data-selection A/B (bitter-lesson lever toward the 13.40 anchor): does training on dclm-edu (a different-lineage edu filter) beat FineWeb-Edu at IDENTICAL tokens? Single-variable: only the training data slice changes; same model/arch/optimizer/schedule/budget/seed.

control_reuse.mechanism: symlinked Phase-1 baseline_seed{0,1,2}.pt (faithful AdamW 1.7e-3 cosine, 2000 steps, FineWeb-Edu) — identical config/budget/seed -> §C13 control-reuse, NOT retrained

arm_plan.single_variable: data slice only (--data fineweb vs --data dclm); arch=faithful, optimizer=adamw 1.7e-3, schedule=cosine, 2000 steps all

data.treatment: research/datasets/data-selection-dclm-edu (150,107,480 train + 748,210 eval tokens, dclm-edu sha dbad8ad7, 13-gram-decontam vs wikitext/code, 0 dropped)
data.control: FineWeb-Edu sample-10BT stream (the existing pretrain data)

confound_check.detail: identical model (596M) + identical token budget; only DATA differs -> train_flops identical, ratio 1.000

smoke.detail: dclm treatment arm GPU smoke (4 steps): DATA=dclm-edu 150M loaded, trains, checkpoints, exit 0

probe.source: faithful build measured (same model/config; dclm uses in-memory tokens, no streaming overhead)

verdict_metric: OOD-BPB (wikitext2_val + code_py) via eval-harness + text-lm-v3 downstream; across-seed 95% CI (treatment vs control). Pre-registered: this is a data-SELECTION delta at fixed tokens, NOT an anchor-closing claim.
